# YesDrop

> YesDrop is a web app that runs email-based approval workflows on autopilot. Send an approval request by email, set a deadline, and let automatic reminders chase the reply. Every response tracked in one dashboard. Approvers decide in one click straight from their inbox, with no account and no login.

## What it does

- Send approvals by email; the approver clicks Approve or Reject right in the email. No sign-up required.
- Deadlines enforce themselves: unanswered requests are marked "ignored" once the date passes.
- Automatic reminders nudge non-responders until they reply or the deadline hits.
- One dashboard tracks status, history, attachments, and reminders for every request.

## Who it is for

Business teams that need fast sign-offs: expense approvals, contract and MSA sign-off, hiring/offer approvals, and launch go/no-go decisions.

## Pricing

Free to start. No credit card required.
